verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a US-only, fully distributed firm. The contact page says it has no physical offices and lists only a Palo Alto mailing address. Advising on GDPR and PIPEDA and filing foreign trademarks via the Madrid Protocol is a related but different capability. It does not mean the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in other countries, so a founder expanding abroad gets no stated in-country presence.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm

citations.quote: European Union (GDPR), Canada (PIPEDA) and other foreign data protection laws.
Filing and prosecuting domestic and foreign trademark applications, including International Applications under the Madrid Protocol.
